what: THE HAND HALF of the prediction for the two trained TinyLlama T32 two-block bundles (layers 7..9 of pg_rot1_export_T32; dense = held-out ho00, zero = the all-zero plane), written 2026-10-17 ~10:45 UTC BEFORE the gate reads either bundle past `load`, after the computed half (`prediction_tinyllama_l2_{dense,zero}.json`, validated OK x4 on rung-K4 / rung-P2 / rung-E32 / rung-K8 records). The law is the 125M round's: every figure is SHAPE-INDEPENDENT (must equal 125M's) or SCALES by an arithmetic law written here. Figures the round could not predict to the unit are named as such.
honesty_note: The failing-first probe (probe_before_port/, 10:2x UTC) ran `load` and `replay` with the UNEDITED tools on the dense bundle before this file was written, so P1's integrity figures and P2's replay counts were SEEN first; they are listed for completeness and are not predictions. Everything from P3 on was not observed before this file.

P3_hash_layer.distinct_salted_leaves: not predicted to the unit (the sampled-column class)

T_tinyllama_specific.T1_pad_set: {F, L, Tab} pad; {D, Ht, Kv, Q, S, T} do not (the computed half: CHECKED from the capture, all derived draw counts equal) -- the runbook's [UNCHECKED] item 4 is now checked
T_tinyllama_specific.T2_F_indicator: hidden 5632 inside 8192 has NO closed BitForm (neither 5632 nor 2560 is a power of two), so supp_F is the builder's public support table; the port must take it from the capture's digest-checked public table, exactly as supp_L at 125M
T_tinyllama_specific.T3_per_stage_tables: stage 0 (layer 7) and stage 1 (layer 8) carry DIFFERENT exp tables (e_s 1 vs 2) and act tables (SiLU (-1,-10) vs (-4,-13)) and different weight folds; the U8 byte table, the RoPE pair and the shape-only indicator tables are equal across stages
T_tinyllama_specific.T4_act_128: act[128] == 0 in both stages' activation tables (the condition ruling S38-F1(a) refused otherwise; the trained tree no longer carries that refusal, finding G-1, so the gate checks it from the bundle)
T_tinyllama_specific.T5_window: D_max 1,482,910, norm window 32 (C-6 on): D24's formula, equal to the bundle's declared d_max and norm_wrho (computed half: CHECKED)
